title: Release Target for Holds for Overdue Payment — Northbridge Specialty Tiers Collections Schedule
content:
**Schedule rule.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, the release target for a hold placed on an enrollment for an overdue payment is set by when the enrollment's fills shipped:

- When fills have shipped and none shipped fewer than one whole month before today, the release target is zero, and the whole open balance is collected.
- When some fills shipped one or more whole months before today and others shipped fewer than one whole month before today, the release target is the cost share of the fills shipped in that last month, which may stay open.
- Otherwise the release target is the specialty credit limit of the member's tier.

## Specialty credit limit by tier (used in the last case)

| Tier | Specialty credit limit |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | $250.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | $250.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | $300.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | $300.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | $500.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | $500.00 |

## Reading ship dates

The number of whole months between a ship date and today is the count of calendar months from that date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the ship date's day of the month. A fill shipped fewer than one whole month before today shipped in the last month.

## Cases (assumed: today is 2026-10-08)

| Shipped fills (ship date, cost share) | Whole months back | Release target |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-05 $120.00; 2026-08-05 $120.00; 2026-09-05 $120.00 | 3, 2, 1 | zero |
| the same three fills, plus 2026-09-20 $210.00 | 3, 2, 1, 0 | $210.00 |
| only 2026-09-25 $95.00 | 0 | the tier's specialty credit limit, for example $500.00 on Northbridge Specialty Total Care |
| no shipped fill | n/a | the tier's specialty credit limit |

## The one-month line

A fill shipped on 2026-09-08 lies one whole month back and is not in the last month. A fill shipped on 2026-09-09 lies zero whole months back and is in the last month.
